headline: Need a courier for an order? Business & Life can coordinate the delivery.
body: Restaurants, fast-food businesses and local shops can connect eligible Business & Life customer orders to an approved Courier pickup, tracking and secure handoff workflow.

business.headline: You have the order. Coordinate the courier.
business.body: For eligible Business & Life customer orders, the app can quote delivery, dispatch an approved Courier after payment/readiness gates, track status and keep the delivery fee separate from merchandise revenue.

courier.headline: Want to deliver local orders?
courier.body: Approved Couriers can set vehicle/capacity/radius, availability and receive eligible assignments inside the delivery workflow.

flow: Customer chooses Delivery on a Business & Life order
System creates a delivery quote from the active pricing rule
Delivery completes and delivery money stays separate from merchandise revenue

standaloneExtension.name: Standalone Business Courier Booking
standaloneExtension.desiredPromise: A Merchant could request a Courier for a delivery created outside the Business & Life Marketplace by entering pickup, dropoff and package/order details.

share.business: Run a restaurant, fast-food business or shop? For eligible Business & Life customer orders, the app can coordinate an approved Courier pickup and delivery workflow. {REFERRAL_URL}
share.courier: Want to deliver local orders? Approved Business & Life Couriers can receive eligible assignments with pickup, tracking and secure handoff workflows. {REFERRAL_URL}
